name: Escape Your Boss
storyline: It is Monday, 5:02 PM, at Megacorp Tower. Jean-Michel, a mild-mannered accountant, has a ticket for the France–Brazil match at the stadium, kickoff at 8:45 PM. His boss has other plans: an urgent TPS report, a floor locked down, and every exit guarded. Pulling an old ninja outfit from his locker, Jean-Michel sets out to escape the building floor by floor, past the cafeteria, the server room, the endless board meeting and the rooftops, then across the parking garage, the subway and the ring road. On the way he faces his coworkers, the HR Director, the security chief and Kage, a mysterious ninja hired by a rival company, with the boss never far behind.
summary: Escape Your Boss is a 2D pixel-art action platformer. Jean-Michel, an overworked accountant, wants to leave the office in time to watch the France–Brazil match at 8:45 PM, but his boss has locked down the whole floor. Dressed as a ninja, he fights his way down Megacorp Tower floor by floor, facing coworkers, security guards and office-themed bosses. The campaign can be played solo or in online co-op with up to four players. The game also includes a level editor and bonus modes.
